closure_scope: current indexed/public source tranche only; not a permanent global claim that no third family can ever exist

family_independence_definition.principle: independence is determined by policy lineage/provenance, not by the amount of downstream modification or performance
does_not_add_a_family: fine-tune of an already admitted policy family
LoRA/adapter-only derivative of an already admitted policy family
distillation from an already admitted policy family when the resulting policy is explicitly represented as that family lineage
head swap or task-specific modification whose primary policy base/weights/architecture remain an admitted family
family_independence_definition.does_not_automatically_collapse_families: sharing generic third-party components such as a vision or language encoder does not by itself prove same-family lineage; ambiguous cases require independent provenance review
admission_requires: no declared or source-level derivation from an already admitted policy family sufficient to make it a within-family variant
public BEHAVIOR 2026 R1Pro observation/action adapter already present in a pinned public revision
public BEHAVIOR 2026 training contract already present in a pinned public revision
public serving/evaluator-compatible contract already present in a pinned public revision
checkpoint or complete recipe/checkpoint-selection provenance that can be frozen before outcome access

evidence.openeta_cross_product: not source-qualified; BEHAVIOR environment is marked adapted while listed policy adapters are unmarked
evidence.openral_cross_product: BEHAVIOR R1Pro path is documented for organizer GR00T N1.7 only
evidence.allenai_2026_bridge: issue #114 remains open; existing merged #115 explicitly labels current BEHAVIOR path as 2025-only
evidence.same_family_public_checkpoint: a public BEHAVIOR 100-task GR00T N1.7 multitask fine-tune exists, but it remains GR00T family and therefore cannot increase family count
evidence.broad_search_result: no public non-pi/non-GR00T family was found with the full R1Pro adapter + 2026 training + serving + checkpoint/recipe chain

reopen_conditions: organizer baselines surface adds a genuinely independent third policy family and a source-qualified BEHAVIOR-compatible contract chain
OpenETA publishes and marks an explicit BEHAVIOR R1Pro cross-product adapter for an independent policy family together with training/serve/checkpoint provenance
OpenRAL publishes BEHAVIOR R1Pro compatibility for a non-pi/non-GR00T family together with training/serve/checkpoint provenance

AllenAI issue #114 changes/closes and a named independent policy family separately satisfies action-interface, training, serving, and checkpoint/recipe requirements; protocol bridge alone is insufficient
a new public repository/checkpoint outside the watched surfaces is discovered that satisfies all frozen admission criteria
any watched source change triggers zero-authority requalification; source change never auto-admits a family
explicit_non_reopen_events: new snapshots of an already admitted family
generic policy adapter plus generic environment support without an explicit cross-product path
AllenAI protocol bridge completion without a compatible independent policy contract
unmerged PR, social claim, or paper without public adapter/training/serving/checkpoint provenance

watch_coverage_limit.known_limitation: the narrow source watch cannot detect a completely new unlinked repository or checkpoint
watch_coverage_limit.mitigation: perform a low-frequency broad public-source sweep as a search-maintenance action; such a sweep remains zero-authority and may only nominate candidates for the same admission gate
